name: the-forest-link
title: The Forest
description: Rediscover the joy of getting lost on the web with theforest.link
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: go-to-a-random-site
commands.title: Go for a Walk
commands.description: Open a random website from The Forest

commands.name: view-walk-history
commands.title: View Walk History
commands.description: Revisit websites discovered on previous walks

commands.name: plant-a-website
commands.title: Plant a Website
commands.description: Submit a website to grow The Forest

tools.name: take-a-walk
tools.title: Take a Walk
tools.description: Finds a random website in The Forest and saves it to walk history

tools.name: get-walk-history
tools.title: Get Walk History
tools.description: Gets websites discovered during previous walks through The Forest

tools.name: clear-walk-history
tools.title: Clear Walk History
tools.description: Permanently clears all locally saved Forest walk history after confirmation

tools.name: plant-website
tools.title: Plant Website
tools.description: Submits a website to The Forest for consideration after confirmation

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
